title: Show the location for events in the Digital Calendar popup
line: The Digital Clock's agenda now shows each event's location under its title.
explanation: Calendar plugins such as PIM Events already pass a location for each event, but the calendar QML component's EventDataDecorator did not expose it, so the Digital Clock agenda could only show title, times and notes. The change adds a location property to the decorator and shows it as "Location: …" in smaller, indented, wrapping plain text under the event title (with the notes below it), hidden when empty and included in the item's accessible description.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: show event locations in the agenda

Calendar plugins already provide a location for each event, but the
calendar component did not expose it to QML. Expose it and show it below
the event title in the agenda, together with the notes, in smaller text.

BUG: 526415

media.caption: Master: three events with locations set, the agenda shows only times, titles and notes
With the fix: locations appear under the titles; the event without a location is unchanged apart from smaller notes
